decision: routed to figure-it-out, not Feature or Autonomous-run alone
why: seven distinct test methodologies across a financial ledger is an ambitious multi-part change, which poteto-mode routes to figure-it-out even when a narrower playbook fits

decision: captured the pre-change baseline before writing any test
why: the harness has to read as old value vs new value, so the run can prove it moved something
evidence: npm test exit 0, 148 vitest tests in 8 files, 8 SQL ledger stages, 35 SQL assertions

decision: measured baseline mutation score before adding tests
why: mutation score is the only falsifiable measure of whether the new tests actually catch defects

decision: each database-backed suite gets its own database cloned from a template, instead of sharing one and locking
why: concurrent suites writing one database is shared mutable state; eliminating the sharing beats serialising access to it
evidence: measured CREATE DATABASE TEMPLATE at 83ms for the 21-table schema
result: per-suite isolation is cheap enough to use everywhere

decision: built the shared harness first, before any of the seven suites
why: every database-backed technique needs the same three things: its own database, a typed way to call ledger.post, and one oracle for the books

decision: proved the oracle fails on a deliberately corrupted ledger, not just that it passes on a clean one
why: an oracle only ever seen passing is indistinguishable from one that always returns healthy
result: oracle reports unbalancedEntries > 0 on a broken book

decision: found that ledger.post records actor_user_id and never reads it
why: maker-checker separation is the compliance rule the brief names, and the database does not enforce it
evidence: db/post.sql, app.lifecycle_edge.actor_role is written by the seed and read by nothing
result: open, to be pinned by a decision table

decision: found five uncovered races, including a lock-order inversion between settle_maturity and accept_bid
why: the existing concurrency test covers one race out of six and is timing-dependent
evidence: tests/ledger/concurrency.sh covers only the contended accept
result: open, to be covered by unit 7
